HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANALYSIS.title: Analysis
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANALYSIS.description: A value used to enhance specific effects.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MEANDER.title: Meander
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MEANDER.description: Whenever you play 5 Skill cards (default on standard difficulty), deals 3 damage to a random enemy and applies 1 Lift (triggers a number of times equal to Analysis).
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ERUDITION.title: Erudition
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ERUDITION.description: Whenever you play 4 Attack cards (default on standard difficulty), deals damage to a random enemy equal to Analysis, and applies 1 Lift (triggers 4 times).
HOOLHEYAKMOD-GRAVITY.title: Gravity
HOOLHEYAKMOD-GRAVITY.description: An inherent attribute of enemies, equal to 10% of their Max HP (rounded down). When Lift reaches this value, triggers Levitate.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LIFT.title: Lift
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LIFT.description: When its stacks reach Gravity, clears all stacks and triggers Levitate.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LEVITATE.title: Levitate
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LEVITATE.description:
Lose all Block and gain 20 Deconstruction. Damage taken is increased by 50%, and damage dealt is reduced by 70%.
At the end of the turn, takes (Gravity + Lift) × 2 damage, then removes this status and clears Lift.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEIGHTLESS.title: Weightless
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEIGHTLESS.description: Lift gained is doubled. At the end of the turn, loses 1 stack.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-VARIABLE.title: Variable
HOOLHEYAKMOD-VARIABLE.description: When played, choose one effect to activate.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DECONSTRUCTION.title: Deconstruction
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DECONSTRUCTION.description: Whenever you gain Block, consumes an equal number of stacks to negate the Block gained.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASPECTS.title: Aspects
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASPECTS.description: A global field effect. Triggering a new Aspect will replace the existing one. Only 1 can exist at a time.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HARMONIOUS _ASPECTS.title: Harmonious Aspects
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HARMONIOUS _ASPECTS.descrip: Aspects that lean towards providing positive buffs or combo opportunities.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CHALLENGING _ASPECTS.title: Challenging Aspects
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CHALLENGING _ASPECTS.descri: Aspects accompanied by severe negative penalties or extreme risks.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-NEUTRAL _ASPECTS.title: Neutral Aspects
HOOLHEYAKMOD-NEUTRAL _ASPECTS.descriptio: Aspects with double-edged effects, or that are capable of altering fundamental mechanic rules.
